requirements.normative_requirement: Every lease belongs to exactly one immutable complete TCB generation.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Lease behavior changes under mixed TCB

requirements.normative_requirement: No in-place adapter/compiler/backend/kernel/rootfs/agent replacement occurs in a running production lease.
requirements.primary_verification: Attempted hot replacement blocks or drains.

requirements.normative_requirement: New generations serve only new leases; old generations drain or are explicitly destroyed.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Vulnerable old generation accepts new work

requirements.normative_requirement: Rollback selects a complete previously attested generation and is exercised before release.
